findings.claim: GET /ledger/1 serves a signed entry, no key, no account
findings.detail: HTTP 200; event_id eb22294404b20215…; schnorr sig present; pubkey 6786e18a864893a9…

findings.claim: POST /verify-proof (no body) returns a self-recompute recipe
findings.detail: HTTP 200; names NIP-01 id recompute + schnorr verify + RFC 8785 JCS; published_pubkey pinned in-band

findings.claim: wg-identity#21: a proof it cannot resolve returns a DISTINCT not-evaluated signal, not a pass
findings.detail: POST /verify-proof {event_id:eb22294404b2…} → HTTP 404 naming the reason ("no durably-stored event … predates this fix … HMAC fallback"); it does not return valid:true

findings.claim: a mis-shaped event yields valid:false, never a silent pass
record_sha256 independently recomputes from the published record
findings.detail: naive canonicalisation ≠ published record_sha256; exact preimage not published, so we did NOT establish this. Not a defect claim about their hash — a gap in our reconstruction. Resolvable with the operator's preimage dict.

findings.claim: preimage_fields_authorized:true on a proof postdating commit 78e6a921
findings.detail: POST /verify-proof {event_id:7aa10c9783ef…} → HTTP 404 "no durably-stored event". The same id returned HTTP 200 with valid:true and preimage_fields_authorized:true earlier in this session. The check did not fail; it could not be performed, because the fixture is no longer retrievable. Says nothing about their verifier — it is a durability property of the vector.

findings.claim: decision_ref recomputes independently from the published payload and declared field list
findings.detail: the response carried no proof_payload.decision_ref_preimage_fields to rebuild from

findings.claim: a tampered proof is refused, and the checks that could no longer run are not reported as failed
findings.detail: the response carried no event.content to alter

derivation_gate.rule: every finding must name the live response it was decided from, or the run fails before publication
derivation_gate.proves: the verdict was selected from a response actually fetched in this run
derivation_gate.does_not_prove: that the selection logic is correct
